sell.title: How selling works
sell.intro: {brandName} is built for sellers who want to reach the Kurdish community directly, with fees that stay small and rules that stay the same for everyone.

account.title: Create a seller profile
account.body: A seller profile carries your display name and, once you are verified, a badge buyers can see.

category.title: Choose a category
category.body: The category decides which details a listing needs, how long it runs, how many photos it takes, and whether a verified account is required.

details.title: Fill in the details
details.body: Each category asks for its own fields — mileage and fuel type for a car, storage and warranty for a phone. Required fields are checked before a listing can be published.

images.title: Add photos
images.body: Every photo is re-encoded on upload, and location data embedded by your camera is stripped before anyone else can see it.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: Some categories publish straight away. Others go to review first, which is why a high-value listing takes longer to appear.

sell.availabilityBody: Listings, photos and search are built and working through the platform's API. The seller dashboard for creating and managing listings in the browser is not built yet — it arrives with the accounts release, together with signing in on the web.
